method: St Croix, US Virgin Islands: the north shore from Salt River to Cane Bay and Northstar, Long Reef off Christiansted, Buck Island Reef National Monument, and the west end from Frederiksted to Butler Bay. Lists used: Blue Salt Divers' St Croix dive-site page (divexp.com, Dive Experience, now redirects to Blue Salt Divers, so they count once); Sweet Bottom Dive Center's shore-dive page; Cane Bay Dive Shop's tour page, which names the Wall, the Pier, Armageddon and the five Butler Bay wrecks but not the wrecks individually; the USVI tourism dive-site pages (GoToStCroix and VisitUSVI, counted as one tourism-board list); and the NPS Submerged Resources dive guides to Salt River Bay and Buck Island (archived 2023 snapshots of 2012 text; the live pages return 404), counted as the one official list. St Croix Ultimate Bluewater Adventures publishes no named sites (its pages say only wall, reef, wreck and pier), says it does not scuba dive Buck Island, and is not counted; the N2 the Blue domain is now parked and its successor Nep2une publishes no readable list; Anchor Dive Center's site is gone and Sweet Bottom names no boat sites. No official mooring list with names is readable: the St Croix Diving Association moorings and the DPNR/East End Marine Park mooring pages name no dive sites. A site is counted on at least two independent lists and recreationally divable; Salt River Canyon's walls are counted at their 25 to 80 ft mooring depths; the Butler Bay wrecks are two rows (shallow and deep) because the tourism list splits them that way. The Anchors (NPS) and Twin Anchors (Blue Salt) are treated as one site on the strength of the matching description of two 1700s Danish anchors, which is the least certain merge. Counted 2026-10-14.
